title: Document RAG QA Assistant
description: An intelligent retrieval-augmented generation engine that allows users to upload PDF/text documents and query them in natural language. Utilizes vector embeddings and Google Gemini API.

title: Customer Segmentation & Sentiment Analysis
description: Uses RFM analytics and unsupervised K-Means clustering to discover customer groups. Integrates transformer-based sentiment analysis on customer reviews to find cohort satisfaction patterns.

title: Sales Analytics & Forecasting Dashboard
description: An interactive e-commerce and retail sales tracking dashboard featuring ARIMA-based predictive forecasting, cohort retention tracking, and interactive key performance indicator metrics.
